:''Not to be confused with {{Name|Nautilus Fossil|class=inline}}.
The '''Nautilus Shell''' is found via [[foraging]] at [[The Beach]] in [[Winter]]. The player may randomly receive one in the mail from [[Demetrius]]. It can also be received as a gift at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]]. It may also spawn on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]] during any season. It may also be found foraging on levels 1-29 of [[the Mines]]  while the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]] is enabled, or the [[Quests#Danger In The Deep|Danger in The Deep]] quest is active. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] turtle with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]], or randomly found at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|120}}. One Nautilus Shell can be purchased from [[Demetrius]]' [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|50|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s.

Several [[Crab Pot]] [[fish]] may produce a Nautilus Shell in a [[Fish Pond]] when the population of the pond reaches 9.

==Bundles==
A Nautilus Shell is used in the {{Bundle|field research||y}}.

==Recipes==
Nautilus Shell is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
The Nautilus Shell can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[File:Shirt139.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Strapped Top]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
One Nautilus Shell is requested by [[Sturgeon]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 7 to 10.
